title: God’s Covenant with Abram

questions.question: What did God promise to be for Abram?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:1: "Fear not, Abram, I am your shield."

questions.question: To what did God compare Abram's offspring?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:5: God told Abram to count the stars - so shall his offspring be.

questions.question: Why was Abram counted as righteous?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:6: "he believed the LORD, and he counted it to him as righteousness."

questions.question: What was Abram concerned about?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:2-3: Abram was concerned because he had no children.

questions.question: What did God promise to give Abram's descendants?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:18: God made a covenant to give Abram's offspring the land.

questions.question: Who did Abram say was his current heir?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:2: Abram thought Eliezer would be his heir since he had no children.

questions.question: What came over Abram as the sun was going down?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:12: "a deep sleep fell on Abram... dreadful and great darkness."

questions.question: How long would Abram's descendants be oppressed in another land?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:13: "your offspring will be... afflicted for four hundred years."

questions.question: What animals did Abram bring for the covenant ceremony?
options: A heifer, goat, ram, turtledove, and pigeon
questions.correctAnswer: A heifer, goat, ram, turtledove, and pigeon
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:9: God instructed Abram to bring five animals for the covenant.

questions.question: What passed between the cut pieces of the animals?
options: A smoking fire pot and flaming torch
questions.correctAnswer: A smoking fire pot and flaming torch
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:17: A smoking fire pot and flaming torch passed between the pieces.

questions.question: Whose sin was "not yet complete" according to Genesis 15:16?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:16: "the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."

questions.question: What nation would God judge for oppressing Abram's descendants?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:14: "I will bring judgment on the nation that they serve."

questions.question: What did Abram drive away from the carcasses?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:11: "And when birds of prey came down... Abram drove them away."

questions.question: From what river to what river did God promise the land?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:18: "from the river of Egypt to... the Euphrates."

questions.question: In what generation would Abram's descendants return to Canaan?
questions.explanation: Genesis 15:16: "they shall come back here in the fourth generation."

key_verse_text: And he believed the Lord, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
